# Navera Marketing

> Navera Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Sonipat, Haryana, India. Tagline: "A New Era of Brand Growth". Services: social media management (Instagram, Facebook), reels and video production with on-location shoots, graphic design and branding, website development (basic, catalogue and e-commerce), paid advertising on Meta and Google, and SEO with Google Business Profile support.

- All prices are negotiable.
- Monthly plans (service fee, GST extra if applicable, ad spend separate): Essential Rs 9,999/month (10 reels, 10 stories, 2 shoots); Business Growth Rs 19,999/month (16 reels, 16 stories, 8 graphics, 4 shoots, Google Business Profile support); Premium Growth Rs 24,999/month (reels as required, 20 stories, 12 graphics, basic SEO, campaign coordination).
- Websites (one-time): Basic Rs 6,999; Catalogue Rs 14,999 (hosting included); E-commerce Rs 29,999 (hosting + domain included).

- Location: Sonipat, Haryana, India. Serves Sonipat city and Sonipat district (Kundli, Murthal, Rai, Ganaur, Gohana, Kharkhoda) and works online with brands across India.
- Contact (WhatsApp and phone): +91 95881 93144, +91 99961 01371, +91 91382 78999
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/navera.marketing/
